title: Constructible heart
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber] $p,a,q,k_0,k$, a
prime $\ell\neq p$, write $\Ql=\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-numbers], choose an algebraic closure
$\Qlb$ of $\Ql$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure], and choose a finite-type
[def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties] $k$-scheme $Y$ and a finite extension
$E/\Ql$ contained in $\Qlb$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $\Lambda\in\{E,\Qlb\}$. For $\Lambda=E$, use
the rationalized coefficient category $D^b_c(Y,E)$
[def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]; its integral representatives have
finite-level reductions in $D^b_c(Y,A_{E,n})$, i.e. satisfying the finite-torsion constructibility
condition [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility]. For $\Lambda=\Qlb$, use
the common-stage category $D^b_c(Y,\Qlb)$
[def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. Let
$D^{\leq0}_c(Y,\Lambda)$ and $D^{\geq0}_c(Y,\Lambda)$ be the classes of the standard pair on $D^b_c(Y,\Lambda)$
[def-weil-constructible-standard-tstructure]. Since $Y$ is of finite type over $k$, this pair is a bounded
$t$-structure [def-weil-t-structure] on $D^b_c(Y,\Lambda)$, the *standard $t$-structure*
[prop-constructible-truncations]; for every $m\in\mathbf Z$ write $\tau^{\leq m}$ and $\tau^{\geq m}$ for its
truncation functors, the constructible truncation functors. As in every $t$-structure,

$$
\begin{aligned}
 D^{\leq0}_c(Y,\Lambda)&=
 \{K:\tau^{\geq1}K=0\},\\
 D^{\geq0}_c(Y,\Lambda)&=
 \{K:\tau^{\leq-1}K=0\}.
\end{aligned}
$$

The *constructible heart* $\Sh_c(Y,\Lambda)$ is the full subcategory of $D^b_c(Y,\Lambda)$ on the objects of
$D^{\leq0}_c(Y,\Lambda)\cap D^{\geq0}_c(Y,\Lambda)$, that is, the heart of the standard $t$-structure
[def-weil-t-structure]; it is an abelian category [prop-weil-heart-abelian].

proof.text: Use intrinsic integral boundedness and standard-truncation stability to induce the ambient t-structure on the intrinsic full subcategory. For rational localization use the prescribed isomorphism-closed classes, their shift comparisons, tensor induction for orthogonality, and localized integral truncation triangles. Every rational object has an integral representative, giving boundedness. The class functions determine the t-structure uniquely.

Finite scalar extension preserves every integral cohomological degree bound: the exact ordinary scalar functor preserves homology vanishing and sfIntegralOrdinaryComparison identifies its values with completed extension. The rational scalar functor has those same integral object representatives, hence preserves both rational classes. Define the common-stage t-structure by the prescribed existential classes. Inclusion shift comparisons give shift closure. Represent an arbitrary morphism between opposite classes at one common field; scalar preservation and rational orthogonality make its representative zero. Inclusion maps preserve zero. Apply the exact inclusion to the truncation triangle at the object's literal stage. Its finite-stage bounds give common-stage boundedness. The two class functions give uniqueness.

The zero classes identify the heart. Apply the general t-structure truncation-vanishing criteria and the abelian-heart theorem, transporting the full subcategory along equality of its predicates. These are the pre-existing proved heart-property clauses.

proof_origin.place: Proposition 6.8.11(3), scalar localization and common-stage construction; formalized by H1

split_report.summary: Checked against the master blueprint text (no slopmaster2 copy, no Lean). The source defines Sh_c(Y,Λ), Λ∈{E,Qlb}, as the intersection of {τ^{≥1}K=0} and {τ^{≤-1}K=0} for truncation functors 'obtained from the standard t-structure', a t-structure no node defined for these categories. New definition node def-weil-constructible-standard-tstructure gives the standard pair explicitly (integral level by cohomology sheaves of \hat O_{E,Y}-modules, rational level as isomorphism closure of the integral classes, following prop-weil-localized-tstructure and Bhatt–Scholze 6.8.11(3)/6.8.14(2), Qlb level as isomorphism closure of finite stages). The item now says that this pair is a bounded t-structure by prop-constructible-truncations (the existing statement of the constructible truncations for Λ∈{E,Qlb}), uses the general notion of t-structure and heart def-weil-t-structure (Mathlib: TStructure, TStructure.heart), keeps the τ-characterization of the source as the general t-structure fact (Mathlib isLE_iff_isZero_truncGT_obj / isGE_iff_isZero_truncLE_obj), and cites prop-weil-heart-abelian for 'abelian' (Mathlib lacks it). Added the deps on def-weil-l-adic-numbers, def-weil-algebraic-closure, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, which the statement uses. Removed the source's closing gloss ('its objects are constructible Λ-adic sheaves whose finite-level reductions satisfy the finite-torsion constructibility condition'), which uses an undefined notion and is not part of the definition; the finite-torsion condition is kept where the source states it for integral representatives.
